_self.doc: The entity that owns this output/script.

_activator.doc: The entity that triggered this chain, if any.

chain.doc: String-keyed pass-variable accumulator for the currently-executing connection.

globals.doc: Per-session persistent key/value storage. Transfers across levels.

mapglobals.doc: Per-map-session key/value storage; resets on map load. Saves, but does not transfer across levels.

members.name: position
members.doc: World-space position.

members.name: velocity
members.doc: Current velocity.

members.name: angles
members.doc: Euler rotation, degrees.

members.name: GetValue
members.doc: Reads a reflected C# field by name.

members.name: SetValue
members.doc: Writes a reflected C# field by name.

members.name: classname
members.doc: The C# class name of this entity, e.g. 'FuncDoor'.

members.name: insidebrush
members.doc: Entities currently inside this trigger volume. Only valid on brush-based volumes (FuncTrigger and friends).

members.name: applyimpulse
members.doc: Applies an instantaneous impulse.

members.name: applyimpulseat
members.doc: Applies an impulse at a world-space point, inducing torque.

members.name: applyforce
members.doc: Applies a continuous force for this physics step.

members.name: applyforceat
members.doc: Applies a continuous force at a world-space point, inducing torque.

members.name: addcondition
members.doc: Applies a named status condition, e.g. 'burning'.

members.name: removecondition
members.doc: Removes a named status condition if present.

members.name: moveto
members.doc: Requests AI pathing toward a point or entity. Requires an AI-driven controller.

members.name: ispathcompleted
members.doc: Whether the AI has reached its current move target. Requires an AI-driven controller.

indexer.doc: Reads/writes a global value by key.

members.name: x
members.doc: X component.

members.name: y
members.doc: Y component.

members.name: z
members.doc: Z component.

members.name: x
members.doc: X component.

members.name: y
members.doc: Y component.

members.name: hit
members.doc: Whether the trace hit anything.

members.name: point
members.doc: World-space hit point. Meaningless if hit is false.

members.name: normal
members.doc: Surface normal at the hit point.

members.name: entity
members.doc: The entity that was hit, if any. Never set for bsptrace.

globalFunctions.name: stopchain
globalFunctions.doc: Halts remaining connections in this output; suppresses this connection's own refire.

globalFunctions.name: spawnentity
globalFunctions.doc: Spawns a new entity of the given classname.

globalFunctions.name: phystrace
globalFunctions.doc: Raycasts the physics world (dynamic entities/props). Returns TraceResult.

globalFunctions.name: bsptrace
globalFunctions.doc: Raycasts static world geometry only. Returns TraceResult.

globalFunctions.name: playsound
globalFunctions.doc: Plays a soundscript entry, optionally positioned in 3D.

globalFunctions.name: playparticle
globalFunctions.doc: Spawns a particle system at a position.

globalFunctions.name: entitiesinradius
globalFunctions.doc: Returns all entities within radius of a point.

globalFunctions.name: debugpoint
globalFunctions.doc: Draws a debug point this frame.

globalFunctions.name: debugline
globalFunctions.doc: Draws a debug line this frame.

globalFunctions.name: ispathwalkable
globalFunctions.doc: Whether a straight-line AI path between two points is walkable.
